findings.label: Incorrect
findings.title: Unvetted automatic JVM options plus the production test bypass defeat the single-agent guard
findings.impact: JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS is automatically prepended by the launcher but is not inspected/cleared. It can carry an extra agent/provider option or contoso.requireAgent=false; the latter returns before all agent/configuration/extension checks. Maven source qualification does not protect that deployed launch channel.
findings.requestedFix: Reject or clear unapproved JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS before exec alongside all automatic JVM option sources. Remove the universal production early-return bypass, or confine it to a fixture-only entry/classpath marker that cannot enter deployment. Add focused launcher-option and production-main guard tests without shipping an anti-pattern.

findings.label: Incorrect
findings.title: Packaged Spring Boot SDK classes are invisible to the guard's system-loader-only check
findings.impact: Spring Boot's launched/context loader resolves nested BOOT-INF classes/libs; ClassLoader.getSystemResource does not establish that those SDK/provider classes are absent. The normal Maven ban is helpful, but this advertised runtime guard is blind to a packaged/nested SDK leak or externally supplied app JAR.
findings.requestedFix: Check the actual application/RuntimeGuard classloader and context classloader, not only the system loader; retain the Enforcer restriction and inspect the packaged application's nested libraries before archive admission. Add a focused launched-classloader resource fixture that must fail.
